{{Quote|This is not a cattle market on Shaum Hii, Lieutenant Tschel. This is the bridge of an Imperial Star Destroyer.|Captain Pellaeon to Lieutenant [[Tschel]]|<ref name="HttE" />}}
The '''''Chimaera''''' {{Pronounced|kaɪˈmɪərə}} was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] that served for over forty years and fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Under command of the famous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], it led the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral's]] [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]] during his brilliant [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In the following years, it became the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. The Remnant would lose the ''Chimaera'' following the Yuuzhan Vong War when it was severely damaged. The starship was eventually recovered by former Imperial Admiral [[Natasi Daala]], who made it the flagship of her private [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the [[Maw Irregular Fleet]].

==History==
===Initiation at Poln===
{{Quote|Captain Thrawn? Your time is running out.''"<br />"''Not at all. You ask me to choose between the death of the ''Chimaera'' or the death of the Golan. I've made my choice. I choose neither.|Nuso Esva and Senior Captain Thrawn, during the battle of the Poln system|<ref name="CoO" />}}
The ''Chimaera'' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] serving the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The ''Imperial II''-class of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] began operating shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EGTVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> After quick thinking against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near [[Gavryn]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] earned a string of swift promotions<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and was promoted to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} command crew.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the ''Chimaera'' was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Calo Drusan]]. [[Senior Commander/Legends|Senior Commander]] [[Grondarle]] was the [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]], and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Pellaeon was the [[Third bridge officer]]. When the ship rendezvoused with the [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'' to pick up [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Nuso Esva|Odo]], a supposed member of the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]], Pellaeon was unsure why the ship had been given mere passenger transport duty in the midst of an ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|rebellion]].<ref name="CoO" />

[[File:Chimaera.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The ''Chimaera'']]
Six unidentified [[Starship/Legends|raiders]] also appeared at the rendezvous, but several of them were [[Skirmish against Nuso Esva's forces|destroyed]] by ''Salaban's Hope''{{'s}} [[Laser cannon/Legends|lasers]] after getting caught in the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]]. Odo and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sorro]] thus came aboard the ''Chimaera'', and the ship headed toward an [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva's commanders)|unremarkable world]], which Odo visited for five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] via the  ''Salaban's Hope''. Captain Drusan soon told his senior staff that the ''Chimaera'' had been chosen to be Odo's personal transport on a special assignment, with their next stop being the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]].<ref name="CoO" />

After a brief one-hour visit to [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]], Odo gave the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] as his next destination. Meanwhile, Pellaeon conducted a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] search for any information on the mysterious Lord Odo, and he came to believe that the man was an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] criminal on the run from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. However, Captain Drusan assured him that Odo's mission had been sanctioned by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself. Upon the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} arrival in the Poln [[Star system/Legends|system]], Drusan pointed out to Pellaeon eight ships that Odo had identified as belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CoO" />

The Imperial [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] ''[[Sarissa]]'' was allowing the Rebel ships free passage, leading Drusan and Pellaeon to suspect collaboration from the [[Candoras sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. Rather than act right away, Drusan elected to trust Odo's plan; accordingly, the ''Chimaera'' conducted an observation of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]] before heading to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. En route, Odo revealed to Pellaeon his belief that [[Troukree]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]], working for a mysterious [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] named Nuso Esva, had infiltrated the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="CoO" />

When the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] arrived at the planet [[Teptixii]], it found itself in the middle of a [[Engagement at Teptixii|battle]], with forty-two ships [[Space warfare/Legends|fighting]] in the engagement sphere. Imperial [[Task Force Admonitor|forces]] were on one side, and Captain [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' contacted the ''Chimaera'' to officially request their help. Drusan and Pellaeon were puzzled by Parck's tactics, as he was seemingly sacrificing two [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] by placing them in front of the more heavily-[[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] ''Admonitor''.<ref name="CoO" />

[[File:Chimaeraentershyperspace.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Chimaera'' jumps to lightspeed.]]
Odo revealed that the [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|opposing fleet]] [[Nuso Esva's realm|belonged]] to Nuso Esva, whose [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|ships]] were more dangerous than they realized; he also suggested that keeping the ''Admonitor'' protected was the only way that Parck could lower its shields long enough to take potshots at the enemy. Esva's [[Unidentified escort ship|patrol ships]] were taking all of the ''Admonitor''{{'s}} hits, however, while powerful but weakly-shielded [[Firekiln]] ships behind them were remaining unscathed. On Odo's advice, the ''Chimaera'' crept up behind Esva's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]; rather than divert half of their [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ships]] to protect the Firekilns from the back, Esva's forces jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="CoO" />

Parck contacted the ''Chimaera'' again to thank them, and Odo delivered a message from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kauf Ularno]] of the Poln system: Parck and his task force were urgently needed at Poln Major, as was their [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]], [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Parck protested, pointing out that his task force was detached from the normal [[Naval Command (Imperial)|Fleet Command]] structure, until a transmission arrived stating that Ularno was invoking [[Directive Four-Seventeen]]: after an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on Governor Ferrouz, all nearby forces were being called to Poln Major.<ref name="CoO" />

The ''Chimaera'' remained in the [[Teptixii system/Legends|system]] while Parck assessed the damage to his fleet, and Odo expressed keen interest in whether Thrawn would be meeting them at Poln Major. Pellaeon only knew Thrawn's reputation as an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] whose [[Politics/Legends|political]] ineptitude had him constantly on thin ice, but the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} nerve-jangling return trip through the Unknown Regions gave Pellaeon new respect for the Senior Captain&mdash;if he led his task force through such unexplored, potentially lethal territory [[Time/Legends|time]] and time again, Pellaeon believed he was certainly not lacking in courage.<ref name="CoO" />

In the Poln system, Drusan began to order Parck's task force to move into close planetary deployment, and he grew angry when a [[Unidentified sensor officer (Chimaera)|sensor officer]] revealed to Pellaeon that a [[Lost Reef|small ship]] had been shadowing them since their first trip to Poln Major. He told Pellaeon that Lord Odo believed the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|ship]] was Nuso Esva, but he grew even more agitated when Odo was suddenly nowhere to be found. While Pellaeon was searching for their passenger, sudden explosions rocked all of the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engine]]-control centers, and Pellaeon was quickly brought up-to-date by a [[Unidentified damage-control officer (Chimaera)|damage-control officer]].<ref name="CoO" />

[[File:Chimaerabottomview.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Chimaera'' glides through space.]]
Pellaeon hastened back to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], donning a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] to protect himself from [[vertigon gas]] that had been released. He heard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and found a mortally wounded Drusan on the floor; the captain revealed that Odo was a charlatan but had promised him a crushing victory over the Rebel Alliance and a promotion. He died in his subordinate's arms, after which Pellaeon was [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] by Senior Captain Thrawn. He learned from Thrawn that Odo was in fact Nuso Esva, and he was ordered to keep the impostor from escaping the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="CoO" />

Pellaeon jabbed Esva in the neck with a [[hypospray]] when he appeared on the bridge, but the victim turned out to be Esva's pilot, Sorro, wearing his master's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. Before the man died, Pellaeon learned that [[Sorro's family|his family]] was likely being held hostage by Esva. Thrawn again contacted Pellaeon, but Esva himself cut into the circuit and told them that the ''Chimaera'' was locked on a crash course with a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan defense platform]]. He also gloated about how he had sabotaged the ship: [[Mark Two seeker]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] in the ventilation shafts.<ref name="CoO" />

Esva was an old enemy of Thrawn's from the Unknown Regions, whose [[Nuso Esva's conquests|mad crusades]] now included a [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|campaign]] against the Empire. While his Firekilns held Parck's task force at bay, he wanted Thrawn to be forced to choose which war machine full of Imperial lives he would save: the [[Golan space defense platform|Golan]] or the ''Chimaera''. Thrawn chose neither, instructing Pellaeon and his crewman [[Rejlii Mithel|Mithel]] to use their [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], nudging the ''Chimaera'' off course by repeatedly drawing in and letting go of Thrawn's tiny ship.<ref name="CoO" />

More of Esva's ships arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and a [[Poln Minor Chosen squadron|group]] of his [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile|missile]]-bearing [[Whisperlike fighter|starfighters]] blasted out from below Poln Minor's surface. Although the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} weapons-control systems had been disabled, Pellaeon's men set their [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to manual, as they were the only ship standing between the missiles and the ''Admonitor''. Unbeknownst to Pellaeon, however, the Rebel Captain [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had infiltrated the Golan, and he led its crew in destroying all of the approaching [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] with the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="CoO" />

[[File:ChimaeraCCG.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The ''Chimaera'' at the Battle of Endor]]
When the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} tractor beam-assisted turn brought it toward the [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] line, it beheld Esva's enormous [[Eastern Fleet]]. Thrawn continued to speak with Esva and used a [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relay]] to boost the signal to the Unknown Regions, tricking the warlord into revealing that two of his [[Stromma|supposed]] [[Quesoth|allies]] were mere tools to him. The signal also reached the Empire's [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who brought the Star Destroyers of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] into the Poln system.<ref name="CoO" />

Esva's fleet was shattered, but Thrawn returned to the Unknown Regions to take care of the warlord's other two armadas. Before he left, he deduced that Esva's visit to Wroona had been because Sorro's family was being held there.<ref name="CoO" /> Pellaeon became the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} new captain,<ref name="HttES" /> and at some point during the war, he was on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. There, he entrusted an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] with delivering a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Errad Brytok]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'': ''[[Star Wars Galaxies#An Empire Divided|An Empire Divided]]''</ref>

===Disaster at Endor===
{{Quote|Captain Pellaeon is a competent commander, and he's made the ''Chimaera'' into one of the finest warships in the fleet.|Grand Admiral Thrawn to Senior Captain Parck|<ref name="CoF">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
The ''Chimaera'' was undergoing weapons testing in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] along with the [[Inexorable (Imperial I-class)|''Inexorable'']], the ''[[Nemesis]]'' and the [[Stormhawk (Imperial I-class)|''Stormhawk'']], when the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|emerged]] from hyperspace in their vicinity aboard the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. Azameen dodged the Star Destroyers' turbolaser fire and escaped the system.<ref name="XwA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

The Empire's war with the Rebel Alliance came to a nexus in the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> when the Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] was being built above the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine hoped to draw the Rebels into a trap,<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and the Chimaera was recalled to Endor as part of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Horst Strage]].<ref name="EGW" /> During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rebel pilot [[Ekelarc Yong/Legends|Ekelarc Yong]] crashed on the ship.<ref name="RotJ" /><ref name="Insider105">{{InsiderCite|105|25 Years of Return of the Jedi!|25 Years of ''Return of the Jedi''!|reprint=1}}</ref>

[[File:Famous_Star_Destroyers_RotJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Ekelarc Yong crashes into the ''Chimaera'' during the Battle of Endor.]]
The ''Chimaera'' was next in the chain of command after the [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']], and with the destruction of both, became acting command ship. After several hours of fighting and the loss of Admiral Strage, Captain Pellaeon became acting [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the fleet and ordered a retreat<ref name="EGW" /> to the nearest [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Annaj/Legends|Cannij Barr]], in the [[Annaj system/Legends|Annaj system]].<ref name="TTB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="EGW" />

A quarrel broke out between the new commander of Death Squadron, who wanted to counterattack the Rebels, and two higher ranking officers: Admirals [[Blitzer Harrsk|Harrsk]] and [[Adye Prittick]]. Harrsk quickly deserted to create his own warlord fief, and Pellaeon accepted to transfer command to Admiral Prittick, who ordered a retreat to the [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul system]],<ref name="EGW" /> in order to protect the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Admiral Prittick briefly commanded the fleet while at Annaj but did not remain in command. ''Chimaera'' remained under Pellaeon's command during the tumultuous years that followed, and under Pellaeon's leadership, it came to be regarded as one of the Empire's most efficiently run Star Destroyers.

===Thrawn's flagship===
{{Quote|The ''Chimaera'' is fully at your command, Admiral.|Captain Pellaeon to Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="HttE" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Reader's Companion" /> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn returned from the Unknown Regions and choose the ''Chimaera'' to be his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. He remembered Pellaeon from the battle of the Poln system and knew that he had turned the ''Chimaera'' into one of the finest [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in the fleet.<ref name="CoF" />

[[File:Poderis system.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Grand Admiral Thrawn on his flagship, the ''Chimaera'']]
Thrawn immediately left his mark on the ship, having a luxury entertainment suite once used by Pellaeon's predecessor turned into a meditation chamber/command room. Thrawn's reorganization of the fleet placed the ''Chimaera'' at the center of his personal armada, along with the Star Destroyers ''[[Death's Head]]'', [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']], ''Inexorable'', ''Stormhawk'', and ''Nemesis''.<ref name="TTSB">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Thrawn soon began training the crew to his own specifications, and when he ordered the ''Chimaera'' to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|obtain]] the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]'', they were put to the test by unexpected complications caused by Han Solo and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Thrawn began [[Thrawn campaign|his campaign]] on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in earnest, starting with an information raid on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. The ''Chimaera'' remained his flagship throughout this devastating campaign, until his death at [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]] at the hands of his [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] bodyguard, [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]]. Pellaeon was forced to call a full retreat.<ref name="TTSB" />

With Grand Admiral Thrawn dead, Pellaeon believed that the Empire was doomed. Reports of Imperial infighting reached the ''Chimaera'', and Pellaeon set course for the Unknown Regions, intending to make a last stand at the edge of civilized space in a grand and tragic battle. Although other Imperial warships began making their way to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], Pellaeon refused to join them, feeling that the ''Chimaera'' could thenceforth never have a true master other than Thrawn. No reports of the ship's activities reached the ears of [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

===New Republic capture===
Nevertheless, Pellaeon was summoned to the Deep Core to serve the clone of Palpatine. During [[Operation Shadow Hand]], Pellaeon was forced to abandon the ''Chimaera'' in the midst of the [[capture of Duro]], losing most of his senior staff in the process and nearly dying himself. Its burnt hulk was salvaged by the New Republic.<ref name="TNEC" />

The ''Chimaera'' was refitted by the New Republic, having been severely damaged at [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Some years later, [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] working for the Imperial Remnant penetrated the New Republic's computer networks and created a false disassembly order for the ship, sending it to the shipyards of [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]]. Upon its arrival, its skeleton crew was [[Battle of Gravlex Med|overcome]] by [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]], who blasted their way through New Republic pickets,<ref name="Gamer 7">{{GamerCite|7|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx}}</ref> eluded the New Republic's Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]],<ref name="NEGTC" /> and escaped to Imperial space. There, they triumphantly returned the ''Chimaera'' to Admiral Pellaeon,<ref name="Gamer 7" /> who assigned Captain [[Ardiff]] to command the ship.<ref name="SotP" />

===Flagship of the Remnant===
{{Quote|I don't trust anyone off the ''Chimaera'' not to be in Disra's pocket.|Admiral Pellaeon to Commander [[Dreyf]]|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
The fortunes of the Imperial Remnant soon took a turn for the worse. In a last ditch effort, Pellaeon had a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] and a [[Computerized Combat Predictor]] installed aboard the ''Chimaera'' for trials. Ultimately, the trials proved unpromising, and Pellaeon began seeking a treaty with the New Republic.<ref name="SotP" />

As the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] shook [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Pellaeon kept the ''Chimaera'' in the [[Pesitiin system/Legends|Pesitiin system]], waiting for New Republic General [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] to arrive and conduct peace talks with him. He was unaware that a [[Sinister Triumvirate]] of Imperials were scheming against him and had [[Mission to Morishim|intercepted]] his courier to the New Republic; when he arrived at [[Pesitiin]], the ''Chimaera'' was [[Battle of Pesitiin|attacked]] by Triumvirate-loyal [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] who were posing as [[Corellian Defense Force|ships loyal]] to Bel Iblis. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessels were destroyed, the ruse failed, and Pellaeon continued to wait aboard his flagship.<ref name="SotP" />

[[File:Gavrisompellaeon.jpg|thumb|left|275px|The Galactic Civil War came to an end onboard the ''Chimaera''.]]
New Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] Han and Leia Organa Solo were able to meet with Pellaeon and hear his proposal, after which he took the ''Chimaera'' to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to confront the Triumvirate's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]]. A brief jaunt to the Remnant's [[Rimcee Station]] was followed by the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} return to Bastion, where it was hailed by a [[Aing-Tii/Legends|mysterious alien ship]] that offered Pellaeon something it claimed he desperately wanted.<ref name="VotF" />

The prize turned out to be proof that the Triumvirate's impostor Grand Admiral Thrawn was in fact the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] "[[Flim (Human)|Flim]]," and the aliens' [[Fold space]] technique brought the ''Chimaera'' to [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], where Pellaeon [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|revealed]] the Triumvirate's ruse. He thus succeeded at suing for peace, and he signed [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace accords]] aboard the ''Chimaera'' with Acting [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Ponc Gavrisom]] of the New Republic. The decades-long Galactic Civil War finally came to an end.<ref name="VotF" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|With ''Chimaera'' still missing, the Moffs will assume that Gilad Pellaeon is dead.|Captain [[Arien Yage]] to Jacen Solo|<ref name="FH1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Battle of Xa Fel.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Chimaera'' lords over a [[Battle of Xa Fel (9 ABY)|defeated]] foe.]]
A fairly long period of peace was punctuated by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[25 ABY]], Pellaeon brought the ''Chimaera'' to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] to support the New Republic in [[Battle of Garqi|battle]] against the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Joining the Imperial forces was [[Force Spike]], a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Chiss Clawcraft]] from [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Thrawn's Household Phalanx]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]]&mdash;the [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Phalanx's]] [[Empire of the Hand]] had intercepted Pellaeon's order recalling all Imperial forces to active duty, and they sent a wing of [[Snubfighter/Legends|fighters]] along to render Pellaeon aid.<ref name="DT2" />

At the [[Battle of Ithor]], Pellaeon and the ''Chimaera'' were in overall command of the joint New Republic-Imperial Remnant defense, despite the protests of New Republic Chief of State [[Borsk Fey'lya]]. Although Ithor's ecosystem was completely devastated by a Yuuzhan Vong [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]], the ''Chimaera'' and the New Republic's ''[[Ralroost]]'' ended the battle by taking out the enemy flagship, the ''[[Legacy of Torment]]''. Pellaeon was then recalled, along with the rest of the Remnant fleet, to defend [[Imperial Space]].<ref name="DT2" />

Eventually, Yuuzhan Vong forces, under Commander [[B'shith Vorrik]], appeared in the [[Bastion system/Legends|Bastion system]], [[Battle of Bastion|destroying]] planetary defense systems with ease and catching the Imperial Navy off guard, as they were expecting the force to attack the [[Hand of Thrawn]] base at Nirauan. Only the ''Chimaera'' responded to the attack with suitable efficiency. Despite this, the Navy was able to hold its own, or so it appeared, until the Yuuzhan Vong pulled back to make way for swarms of thousands of [[grutchin]]s. The Navy responded to the grutchins with what Pellaeon considered to be appalling disorganization. The Remnant took serious losses from Vorrik's forces, and Pellaeon ordered the evacuation of Bastion.<ref name="FH1" />

''Chimaera'' and another ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer, the ''[[Superior]]'', were harried by the Yuuzhan Vong all the way to a gas giant planet further out in the Bastion system, where the ''Chimaera'' took considerable damage before a [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] rammed the bridge of the ship. Pellaeon was nearly killed, but a junior officer pulled him from the bridge and took him to a medical frigate. ''Chimaera'' was later able to limp into the [[Yaga Minor system/Legends|Yaga Minor system]], where it began undergoing repairs.<ref name="FH1" />

For the remaining duration of the war against the Yuuzhan Vong, Pellaeon commanded the fleet from the bridge of a different Star Destroyer, ''[[Right to Rule]]''.<ref name="FH1" /> As [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]], Pellaeon's flagship was the ''[[Megador]]''.

===Second Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|She was never confirmed destroyed.|Darth Caedus upon the arrival of the ''Chimaera'' at the Second Battle of Fondor|<ref name="Revelation" />}}
[[File:Chimaeraapproachesbpfassh.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Chimaera'' at the head of an Imperial armada]]
The ''Chimaera'' was later used by Admiral [[Natasi Daala]] as the flagship of her [[Maw Irregular Fleet]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The ship had been refitted with unique weaponry, [[Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter]]s, remaining from Daala's command of the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]] where the Empire had developed new weapon technologies. These weapons made ''Chimaera'' a serious threat to all enemy vessels as that their shields could not repel the attacks.<ref name="Revelation" />

Daala made a theatrical arrival at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] where the ''Chimaera'' enabled a decisive victory of the Imperial Remnant and the [[Alliance-in-exile]] against [[Darth Caedus]]'s [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Revelation" /> The ship later supported the [[Jedi Coalition]] at the [[Second Battle of Roche]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

===Later history===
In the years following the Second Galactic Civil War, Daala became [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the Galactic Alliance but was quickly [[Plan Delta|deposed]] by the [[New Jedi Order]] in order to end her increasingly tyrannical rule.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> She eventually developed a plot to seize control of the Imperial Remnant. With his position threatened by Daala's ambition to become [[Empress/Legends|Empress]], [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] mobilized a fleet of loyal supporters, including some [[Empire of the Hand]] forces, and moved to destroy Daala and her subversives with a pre-emptive [[Battle over Exodo II|strike]] in [[44 ABY]]. At [[Exodo II]], he engaged the Maw Irregular Fleet, once again led by the ''Chimaera''. [[Tors Remal]] served as the ship captain during the battle.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In Greek myth, the Chimaera was a fantastical fire-breathing beast that combined lion, goat and snake. It was also held to be unconquerable, though it was eventually killed by Bellerophon. Nowadays, the word refers to something made up of disparate parts (usually as a result of grafting or genetic manipulation), or something wildly and grotesquely imaginary. All of those elements went into my decision to name Thrawn's flagship the ''Chimaera''. Disparate elements (human plus Chiss), considered imaginary (and hence not taken seriously by others until Thrawn was ready to move), and unconquerable.|Timothy Zahn|<ref name="HttE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>}}
The ''Chimaera'' was created by [[Timothy Zahn]] for his seminal [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' as the flagship of the primary antagonist, Grand Admiral Thrawn. In [[Wikipedia:Greek mythology|Greek mythology]], the chimaera was a [[Wikipedia:Chimera (mythology)|three-headed monster]] made up of lion, goat and snake parts that was said to be unconquerable. Zahn also considered colloquial usages of the term referring to anything made of disparate parts or to things that are wildly and grotesquely imaginary. He ultimately named the Star Destroyer for its seemingly unconquerable nature, the disparate elements of the Human and Chiss crew, and the concept of the ship being considered imaginary and not being taken seriously by opponents until it was too late.<ref name="HttE20" />

[[File:Mythologicalchimaera.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The mythological chimaera]]
The ''Chimaera'' returned in Zahn's later [[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology|''Hand of Thrawn'' Duology]] as the flagship of Admiral Pellaeon,<ref name="SotP" /> and through its roles in numerous books and other media it went on to become one of the most emblematic starships of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. With its later appearances in the novel ''[[Choices of One]]'' and the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force|Legacy of the Force]]'' series, it achieved an [[in-universe]] history stretching over forty years.<ref name="Revelation" /><ref name="CoO" /> ''Chimaera'' was also the name of a server&mdash;or "Galaxy"&mdash;in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.

In [[1998]], the ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' CD-ROM [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the ''Chimaera'' as one of the Star Destroyers seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']];<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> [[Decipher]]'s [[Death Star II Limited|''Star Wars Customizable Card Game – Death Star II Limited'']] card set again placed the ship at the Battle of Endor in [[2000]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=''Chimaera''}}</ref> This was reiterated in [[2008]] in the ''[[Star Wars Insider 105]]'' article ''[[25 Years of Return of the Jedi!]]''.<ref name="Insider105" />

The ''Chimaera'' made the jump to the rebooted ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Canon|continuity]] in [[2016]] when the ship, along with Grand Admiral Thrawn, joined the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Iron Squadron">{{Rebels|Iron Squadron (episode)}}</ref> Thrawn and the ''Chimaera'' were first depicted in live-action in [[2023]] in the [[Part Six: Far, Far Away|sixth episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''.<ref name="Ahsoka">{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}}</ref>

A [[Micro Machines Epic Collections|set]] of ''Heir to the Empire [[Micro Machines]]'' was released in [[1996]] that included a figure of one of the book's Star Destroyers. However, it was simply labeled "Star Destroyer" and was not identified as the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="Micro Machines">{{Galoob|set=Micro Machines|pack=Epic Collection 1: ''Heir to the Empire''|link=mmepic.asp}}</ref> Similarly, the packaging of a 1998 3¾-inch figure of Grand Admiral Thrawn from [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] included a 3D paper pop-up scene of an unnamed Star Destroyer's bridge. As the figure is based on the [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Heir to the Empire'' comic adaptation]], within whose pages Thrawn boards no other Star Destroyers, this article takes the bridge to be that of the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="Thrawn figure 1998'>{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Grand Admiral Thrawn|link=potf2euthrawn.asp}}</ref>
